# Payward Developer Documentation

- [Payward Services](https://docs.services.payward.com/index.md): Built on 15 years of Kraken operations, Payward Services provides one integration replacing fragmented multi-vendor stacks with a single point for trading, payments, tokenized assets, staking, lending, compliance, and settlement.
- [Use cases](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/get-started/use-cases.md)
- [Authentication](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/get-started/authentication.md): Sign every API request with your API key, a timestamp, and an HMAC-SHA512 signature.
- [V1 signing (legacy)](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/get-started/authentication-v1.md): Sign requests with the API-Nonce header, for existing API keys that use V1 signing.
- [Postman collection](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/get-started/postman.md): Build and test your integration with the Payward Services API collection.
- [Asset, funding rail, and geo coverage](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/get-started/asset-funding-rail-and-geo-coverage.md)
- [Environments](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/testing/overview.md): Move your integration from local development to your hosted test deployment, and then to production.
- [Set up local development](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/testing/setup.md): Configure sandbox access, check your credentials, and receive webhooks on your machine.
- [Sandbox test networks](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/testing/networks.md): See which blockchain networks the sandbox supports, and how to get test funds.
- [Test deposits and withdrawals](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/testing/deposits-and-withdrawals.md): Run a crypto deposit and withdrawal on Ethereum Sepolia, and test Bitcoin on-chain and Lightning deposits.
- [Assets](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/market-data/assets.md): Use the Assets API to discover supported assets, check payment availability, and show market context before users deposit, withdraw, or trade.
- [Asset data best practices](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/market-data/asset-data-best-practices.md): Keep an asset catalog, availability, and price charts current with as few calls as possible, handle missing data and errors, and migrate from the legacy Embed API.
- [Portfolio](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/accounts/portfolio.md): Use the Portfolio API to show account value, asset positions, transaction history, and historical portfolio performance.
- [Check onboarding status](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/verifications/onboarding-status.md): Check verification requirements to see when a user has finished onboarding.
- [Hosted KYC](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/verifications/hosted-kyc.md): Verify users through Payward-managed web or embedded methods.
- [Partner-managed verification](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/verifications/partner-managed-verification.md): Submit user profile data and evidence that your verification provider has already verified.
- [Swaps](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/trade/swap.md): The Swaps API offers institutional FX-style trading. Lock a price for ~2 minutes, execute against the locked quote, then poll until the trade reaches a terminal state.
- [On-chain swaps](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/trade/onchain-quotes.md): The on-chain swaps API lets you create a wallet-funded xStocks quote, submit the returned payload on-chain, and poll until the quote reaches a terminal state.
- [Price trigger swaps](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/trade/price-trigger-swaps.md): Price trigger swaps are price-triggered trades that execute automatically when an asset reaches a target price. Use them to implement strategies like "Buy the Dip" (buy when price drops to a target), "Join the Rally" (buy when price rises to ride momentum), "Take the Profit" (sell when price rises t…
- [Auto Earn](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/earn/auto-earn.md): The Earn API exposes Auto Earn: enable or disable yield generation across eligible assets, read the user's allocations and historical rewards, and discover which assets are Auto Earn eligible by user or by country.
- [Bonded Earn](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/earn/bonded-earn.md): Allocate into Bonded Earn strategies, track each request until it settles, follow allocations through bonding and unbonding, and read historical and upcoming rewards.
- [Conversions](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/payments/conversion-rules.md): The conversions API supports reusable conversion rules and one-off on-demand conversions for fiat ↔ crypto flows.
- [Testing conversions](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/payments/testing-conversions.md): Exercise a conversion rule end to end in the sandbox by simulating an inbound deposit: no real bank transfer or on-chain send required.
- [Deposits and withdrawals](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/payments/deposits-and-withdrawals.md): This guide covers fiat and cryptocurrency deposits and withdrawals through the Payward Services API.
- [Transfers](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/payments/transfers.md): Move assets between accounts or between spot and futures balances.
- [Ramp](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/payments/ramp.md): The Payward Ramp API lets you embed a fiat-to-crypto on-ramp into your application via a hosted checkout flow.
- [Bank links](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/developer-documentation/payments/bank-links.md): Link your users' bank accounts once through a hosted widget, then reference them for deposits, withdrawals, and conversions with opaque, revocable identifiers: no raw bank details ever cross the API.
- [Concepts](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/concepts/overview.md): Understand the terms and relationships shared across Payward Services integrations.
- [Users, accounts, and ownership](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/concepts/users-and-accounts.md): Identify the user and account involved in an operation.
- [Verification, permissions, and eligibility](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/concepts/verification-and-eligibility.md): Separate request authentication, identity checks, and access to an operation.
- [Assets, networks, and payment routes](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/concepts/assets-and-payment-routes.md): Separate what moves, how it moves, and where it arrives.
- [Moving money and exchanging assets](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/concepts/money-movement.md): Choose an operation by its source, destination, and exchange behavior.
- [Transaction lifecycles and settlement](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/concepts/transaction-lifecycles.md): Understand what a response or status proves about an operation.
- [Integration guides](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/guides/overview.md): Find implementation workflows and the checks that establish their outcome.
- [Accept Bitcoin payments and pay merchants in dollars](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/guides/merchant-bitcoin-to-usd.md): For payment processors: receive Bitcoin and deliver US dollars to a merchant’s own bank account.
- [Earn between supplier payments](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/guides/stablecoin-earn-supplier-payments.md): For business payments platforms: earn on eligible stablecoin balances and pay suppliers within your program.
- [Add crypto conversion to your exchange](https://docs.services.payward.com/tabs/guides/exchange-instant-conversion.md): For exchanges: connect deposits, quoted conversion, account balances, and daily settlement reports.
- [API reference](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference.md): Find Payward Services API endpoints, choose an environment, and download the OpenAPI specification.
- [Create derivatives transfer](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/derivatives-transfers/create-derivatives-transfer.md): Creates a transfer between the selected account's spot and futures balances.
- [List assets](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/assets/list-assets.md): List assets available on the platform.
- [Get asset](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/assets/get-asset.md): Get information about a specific asset.
- [List asset rates](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/assets/list-asset-rates.md): List historical OHLCV candles for a single asset against a quote asset.
- [List user assets](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/assets/list-user-assets.md): List assets available to a specific user, with that user's geo restrictions applied.
- [Get user asset](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/assets/get-user-asset.md): Get information about a specific asset for a specific user, with that user's geo restrictions applied.
- [List user asset rates](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/assets/list-user-asset-rates.md): List historical OHLCV candles for a single asset against a quote asset, for a specific user with that user's geo restrictions applied.
- [List on-demand conversions](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/conversions/list-on-demand-conversions.md): Lists on-demand conversions for the selected account, ordered by `created_at` descending.
- [Execute on-demand conversion](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/conversions/execute-on-demand-conversion.md): Executes an on-demand conversion for the selected account. The service calculates the missing amount and processes the conversion in the background.
- [Get on-demand conversion](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/conversions/get-on-demand-conversion.md): Returns an on-demand conversion and its current status.
- [List conversion rules](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/conversions/list-conversion-rules.md): Lists conversion rules for the caller, ordered by `created_at` descending.
- [Create conversion rule](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/conversions/create-conversion-rule.md): Creates a new conversion rule. Provisions the inbound deposit endpoint (IBAN for fiat-source, crypto address for crypto-source) the caller will fund. Once funded, transactions are produced against this conversion rule and become observable via the transactions surface.
- [Get conversion rule](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/conversions/get-conversion-rule.md): Retrieves the current state of a previously created conversion rule.
- [Update conversion rule](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/conversions/update-conversion-rule.md): Updates an existing conversion rule. Replaces the destination, name, and status in a single full-state PUT (matching the autoramp rule update contract). The source side is immutable. Re-create the conversion rule if you need to change input asset, rail, or wallet.
- [Delete conversion rule](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/conversions/delete-conversion-rule.md): Deletes a conversion rule (soft-delete). Inbound funds already received continue to settle; future deposits are rejected. Re-deleting an already-deleted conversion rule returns `404 NotFound`. Partners cannot distinguish "deleted" from "never existed".
- [List conversion rule transactions](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/conversions/list-conversion-rule-transactions.md): Lists transactions produced by a single conversion rule, ordered by `created_at` descending.
- [Get Auto Earn preferences](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/auto-earn/get-auto-earn-preferences.md): Returns the current Auto Earn preferences for the specified account.
- [Set Auto Earn preferences](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/auto-earn/set-auto-earn-preferences.md): Sets Auto Earn preferences for the specified account.
- [Get Auto Earn allocations](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/auto-earn/get-auto-earn-allocations.md): Returns current allocation info for the specified account, plus the total across all assets.
- [Get account Auto Earn assets](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/auto-earn/get-account-auto-earn-assets.md): Returns Auto Earn asset info for assets available to the specified account.
- [Get Auto Earn reward summary](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/auto-earn/get-auto-earn-reward-summary.md): Returns the total historical rewards across every Auto Earn asset of the specified account, converted to the quote currency. Use `GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/earn/auto/rewards` for the per-asset breakdown.
- [List Auto Earn rewards](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/auto-earn/list-auto-earn-rewards.md): Returns the historical rewards of each Auto Earn asset of the specified account. Each amount is a lifetime total, net of any reward fee, in the asset and in the quote currency. Assets that have never paid a reward are omitted. Results are paginated and sorted by asset symbol, A-Z.
- [List upcoming Auto Earn rewards](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/auto-earn/list-upcoming-auto-earn-rewards.md): Returns the reward each Auto Earn asset of the specified account expects to pay out at the next payout, with the date of that payout.
- [Get Auto Earn assets](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/auto-earn/get-auto-earn-assets.md): Returns Auto Earn asset info for a given country.
- [Allocate to a Bonded Earn strategy](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/bonded-earn/allocate-to-a-bonded-earn-strategy.md): Submits a request to allocate funds from the specified account into the bonded earn strategy identified in the path.
- [Deallocate from a Bonded Earn strategy](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/bonded-earn/deallocate-from-a-bonded-earn-strategy.md): Submits a request to deallocate funds of the specified account from the bonded earn strategy identified in the path.
- [List Bonded Earn allocations](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/bonded-earn/list-bonded-earn-allocations.md): Returns current allocation totals for the specified account, grouped by strategy.
- [List Bonded Earn allocation states](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/bonded-earn/list-bonded-earn-allocation-states.md): Returns the current allocation transitions for the specified account, ordered by when each allocation leaves its current state (soonest first).
- [List pending Bonded Earn requests](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/bonded-earn/list-pending-bonded-earn-requests.md): Returns the allocate and deallocate requests of the specified account that are still pending, oldest first by creation time.
- [Get Bonded Earn request status](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/bonded-earn/get-bonded-earn-request-status.md): Returns the status of one allocate or deallocate request of the specified account.
- [List account Bonded Earn strategies](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/bonded-earn/list-account-bonded-earn-strategies.md): Returns the bonded and instant strategies the specified account can allocate into or still holds.
- [Get Bonded Earn reward summary](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/bonded-earn/get-bonded-earn-reward-summary.md): Returns the total historical rewards across every bonded and instant strategy of the specified account.
- [List Bonded Earn rewards by strategy](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/bonded-earn/list-bonded-earn-rewards-by-strategy.md): Returns the historical rewards of each bonded and instant strategy of the specified account.
- [List upcoming Bonded Earn rewards](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/bonded-earn/list-upcoming-bonded-earn-rewards.md): Returns the reward each bonded and instant strategy of the specified account expects to pay at its next reward date.
- [List Bonded Earn strategies](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/bonded-earn/list-bonded-earn-strategies.md): Returns the bonded and instant strategies available in a given country.
- [Look up funding method metadata](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/look-up-funding-method-metadata.md): Retrieve funding method metadata for the selected account using either `method_ids` or `network_id`. Returned metadata does not establish eligibility to deposit or withdraw.
- [Create deposit](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/create-deposit.md): Requests a deposit from an eligible linked bank account into the selected account. The Account Link must be active, and its parent Bank Link connection must be live.
- [List deposit methods](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/list-deposit-methods.md): Returns the crypto and fiat deposit methods available to the selected account for an asset. A page may contain fewer methods than requested or no methods even when `next_page_token` is present. Continue requesting pages until `next_page_token` is absent.
- [Activate deposit method](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/activate-deposit-method.md): Requests activation of a deposit method whose `activation_status` is `needed`. A successful response acknowledges the request; check `activation_status` to determine when the method is ready.
- [List deposit limits](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/list-deposit-limits.md): Returns current deposit limits for the selected account and asset, grouped by funding method.
- [List withdrawal methods](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/list-withdrawal-methods.md): Returns the fiat and cryptocurrency withdrawal methods available to the selected account for an asset. A page may contain fewer methods than requested or no methods even when `next_page_token` is present. Continue requesting pages until `next_page_token` is absent.
- [List withdrawal limits](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/list-withdrawal-limits.md): Returns the selected account's current withdrawal limits by funding method for an asset.
- [List withdrawal holds](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/list-withdrawal-holds.md): Returns the active holds that reduce the selected account's balance available for withdrawal, ordered by scheduled release time. Held funds remain in the account but cannot be withdrawn until the hold ends, so a withdrawal limit whose `maximum_reason` is `balance` can be lower than the account balan…
- [Calculate funding fees](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/calculate-funding-fees.md): Calculates a fee quote for a gross amount using one deposit or withdrawal method. Each request creates a new quote and moves no funds.
- [Create withdrawal](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/create-withdrawal.md): Creates a fiat or cryptocurrency withdrawal from the selected account to a registered funding address or a supported linked bank account.
- [List deposit addresses](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/list-deposit-addresses.md): Lists deposit destinations available for a funding method on the selected account. Reuse a page token only with the account and funding method used to obtain it.
- [Claim deposit address](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/claim-deposit-address.md): Claims a crypto deposit address for a funding method available to the selected account. Bitcoin over Lightning uses a per-payment invoice instead of a reusable address; use Create Lightning invoice. Compatible funding methods can share address limits, so list and reuse an existing address before cla…
- [List funding addresses](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/list-funding-addresses.md): Lists user-added withdrawal addresses registered for the selected account. Omit both filters to list all user-added withdrawal addresses. Use List deposit addresses for claimed deposit addresses.
- [Create funding address](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/create-funding-address.md): Registers a user-added fiat or cryptocurrency funding address for withdrawals on the selected account. Registration may activate an applicable funding method.
- [Create Lightning invoice](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/create-lightning-invoice.md): Creates a single-use BOLT11 invoice for a fixed-amount Bitcoin Lightning deposit. Each request creates a new invoice and is non-idempotent; after an unknown outcome, request a new invoice. Amounts outside the Lightning deposit limits reported by List deposit methods return `400`. Completed deposits…
- [Get funding address](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/get-funding-address.md): Returns one user-added fiat or cryptocurrency funding address registered for the selected account.
- [Delete funding address](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/delete-funding-address.md): Permanently deletes a user-added funding address for the selected account. Claimed deposit addresses cannot be deleted through this operation.
- [Update funding address](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/update-funding-address.md): Renames a user-added funding address for the selected account.
- [Create transfer](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/create-transfer.md): Creates a transfer between accounts in the authenticated caller's program.
- [Simulate funding deposit](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/funding/simulate-funding-deposit.md): Inserts a synthetic successful deposit for a funding method available to the selected account. Use this operation only in non-production test environments. It is unavailable in production.
- [Get portfolio](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/portfolio/get-portfolio.md): Returns one account portfolio snapshot containing account-level values and the per-asset breakdown. Quote-denominated monetary amounts use an `_in_quote` suffix; native asset amounts omit the suffix.
- [List portfolio history](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/portfolio/list-portfolio-history.md): Returns daily portfolio valuation snapshots for an account over the requested time window. Use `assets` to include per-asset balances for selected holdings.
- [List portfolio transactions](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/portfolio/list-portfolio-transactions.md): Lists account portfolio transactions with optional filters for type, asset, status, transaction ID, originating reference, time range, and sort direction. Results are cursor-paginated. Results are ordered newest first by default; set `sort_direction=asc` for oldest first. Page tokens are valid for u…
- [List bank links](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/list-bank-links.md): Lists the account's Bank Links with their nested active Account Links, ordered by link time descending. Links that are still being completed and unlinked links are not returned. Results are paged: follow `next_page_token` until it is absent. Eligibility is computed fresh on every read, so a link's r…
- [Create bank link](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/create-bank-link.md): Creates a Bank Link (a connection between this account and one banking institution) for a funding method that requires linking. Returns it in `pending` with a hosted-widget URL; send the user there to choose their institution and approve access. Each shared bank account that links successfully becom…
- [List Ramp buy cryptocurrency assets](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/list-ramp-buy-cryptocurrency-assets.md): List cryptocurrency assets supported for Ramp buy transactions, including networks and withdrawal methods.
- [Get Ramp checkout URL](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/get-ramp-checkout-url.md): Generate a hosted Ramp checkout URL for the provided transaction configuration. The response echoes the request parameters so the Ramp partner can confirm what was submitted.
- [List Ramp countries](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/list-ramp-countries.md): List countries and subdivision groups supported for Ramp deposits.
- [List Ramp fiat currencies](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/list-ramp-fiat-currencies.md): List fiat currencies supported for funding Ramp transactions.
- [Get Ramp limits](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/get-ramp-limits.md): Retrieve combined min/max limits for a Ramp transaction configuration.
- [List Ramp payment methods](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/list-ramp-payment-methods.md): List fiat funding methods supported for Ramp deposits.
- [Get Ramp prospective quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/get-ramp-prospective-quote.md): Retrieve a prospective quote for a Ramp transaction without reserving liquidity. Use this to preview the from/to amounts before creating a checkout URL.
- [Create Ramp checkout session](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/create-ramp-checkout-session.md): Creates a Ramp checkout for a selected user and returns the widget redirect URL with the checkout UUID in the fragment. No access token is minted here; the widget mints it via the bootstrap call (`BootstrapRampCheckout`). The URL must still be treated as sensitive because the UUID is a capability ha…
- [Get bank link](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/get-bank-link.md): Retrieves a Bank Link and its nested active Account Links. Unlinked links are not returned.
- [Unlink bank link](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/unlink-bank-link.md): Severs the whole Bank Link: the link becomes `unlinked` and every Account Link is soft-removed. Unlinked links disappear from get and list and are rejected for new money movement; Account Link ids remain referenceable in history.
- [Reconnect bank link](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/ramp/reconnect-bank-link.md): Reconnects a Bank Link whose provider connection expired or was revoked. Returns it in `pending` with a fresh hosted-widget URL; the user re-authorizes through the provider, and a stored credential is never reused.
- [List settlement reports](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/reports/list-settlement-reports.md): Retrieves a paginated list of settlement reports available to the authenticated Master User, with optional filters for date range and report type.
- [Get settlement report](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/reports/get-settlement-report.md): Retrieves a settlement report and provides a secure download URL for the authenticated Master User.
- [Create quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/swaps/create-quote.md): Creates an account-funded quote.
- [Get quote limits](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/swaps/get-quote-limits.md): Returns the effective amount limits for a swap on the selected account.
- [Get quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/swaps/get-quote.md): Returns a quote by ID. Use this to check status after creating or executing a quote.
- [Execute quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/swaps/execute-quote.md): Executes a quote that is still `offered` and not expired.
- [List onchain quotes](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/onchain-quotes/list-onchain-quotes.md): Returns onchain quotes for the account. Use `page_size` and `page_token` to page through results.
- [Create onchain quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/onchain-quotes/create-onchain-quote.md): Creates a wallet-funded quote and returns onchain execution details.
- [Get soft quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/onchain-quotes/get-soft-quote.md): Returns a short-lived indicative price for a wallet-funded onchain swap.
- [Get onchain quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/onchain-quotes/get-onchain-quote.md): Returns an onchain quote by ID, including execution details when available.
- [List price-triggered swaps](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/price-trigger-swaps/list-price-triggered-swaps.md): Returns price-triggered swaps for the account. Use `page_size` and `page_token` to page through results.
- [Create price-triggered swap](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/price-trigger-swaps/create-price-triggered-swap.md): Creates a swap that submits a trade when its price condition is met.
- [Get price-triggered swap](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/price-trigger-swaps/get-price-triggered-swap.md): Returns a price-triggered swap by ID. Use this to check status and inspect the requested or executed trade.
- [Cancel price-triggered swap](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/price-trigger-swaps/cancel-price-triggered-swap.md): Cancels a price-triggered swap that is still `active`. Swaps in any other status return `409 Conflict`.
- [Create Travel Rule verification](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/travel-rule-verifications/create-travel-rule-verification.md): Creates a Travel Rule verification case for a known wallet address.
- [Get Travel Rule verification](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/travel-rule-verifications/get-travel-rule-verification.md): Gets a previously returned proactive Travel Rule verification case.
- [Create user](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/users/create-user.md): Create a new account-owned user in the Payward system.
- [Get user](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/users/get-user.md): Retrieve a previously created user by their user ID.
- [Create user account](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/users/create-user-account.md): Create an additional account for an existing user.
- [Get verification](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/verifications/get-verification.md): Get a verification summary for the given user and verification ID.
- [List verifications](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/verifications/list-verifications.md): List verification summaries for the given user.
- [Get verification requirements](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/verifications/get-verification-requirements.md): Get the user's verification state and ordered required actions. The `user_action_required` field is true only when the user or partner can complete an action now. A `wait` action is non-actionable.
- [Submit verification evidence](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/verifications/submit-verification-evidence.md): Submit identity documents, residence documents, selfies, or liveness videos already verified by your provider. This endpoint is available only to approved partners. Provide each file through an HTTPS URL on an approved domain.
- [Create hosted verification](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/verifications/create-hosted-verification.md): Create or reuse the hosted verification required for the user.
- [Update verification profile](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/verifications/update-verification-profile.md): Update a user's verification profile. Changes to verified details may require verification again. Read verification requirements to check the user's status.
- [Create reusable KYC token](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/verifications/create-reusable-kyc-token.md): Create a single-use token that copies the user's approved identity verification into your own Sumsub account through Sumsub Reusable KYC.
- [List webhooks](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/list-webhooks.md): Lists the webhooks registered for the specified account.
- [Create webhook](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/create-webhook.md): Registers a new webhook destination for the specified account.
- [Get webhook](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/get-webhook.md): Retrieves a webhook by id.
- [Delete webhook](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/delete-webhook.md): Hard-deletes a webhook. The endpoint is removed entirely; future events will not be delivered to its URL and historical delivery attempts are no longer retrievable. To stop deliveries while keeping the audit trail, use UpdateWebhook with `disabled = true`.
- [Update webhook](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/update-webhook.md): Updates a webhook's mutable fields. Stripe-style partial PATCH: any field omitted from the request body is left unchanged. Use `disabled = true` to soft-disable an endpoint without deleting its delivery history.
- [List webhook attempts](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/list-webhook-attempts.md): Lists delivery attempts made to this webhook, most recent first.
- [Rotate webhook secret](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/rotate-webhook-secret.md): Rotates the webhook's signing secret and returns the new value.
- [Send webhook test event](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/send-webhook-test-event.md): Sends a test event to the webhook.
- [Quote executed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/quote-executed.md): Quote successfully executed against the partner account.
- [Quote canceled](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/quote-canceled.md): Quote canceled before execution.
- [Quote execution failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/quote-execution-failed.md): Quote execution attempted but failed.
- [User closed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/user-closed.md): The user's account was closed.
- [User disabled](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/user-disabled.md): The user's account became disabled.
- [Conversion deposit completed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/conversion-deposit-completed.md): Inbound funds were credited for a conversion transaction.
- [Conversion deposit failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/conversion-deposit-failed.md): The inbound funding leg failed for a conversion transaction.
- [Conversion deposit held](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/conversion-deposit-held.md): The inbound funding leg is held pending review for a conversion transaction.
- [Conversion withdrawal completed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/conversion-withdrawal-completed.md): Outbound settlement completed for a conversion transaction.
- [Conversion withdrawal failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/conversion-withdrawal-failed.md): The outbound settlement leg failed for a conversion transaction.
- [Conversion quote execution failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/conversion-quote-execution-failed.md): Quote creation or execution failed for a pre-quote conversion transaction.
- [Conversion blocked by travel rule](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/conversion-blocked-by-travel-rule.md): A pre-trade Travel Rule check blocked the conversion before any quote execution.
- [Conversion quote executed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/conversion-quote-executed.md): Quote execution completed for a conversion transaction.
- [Swap transaction changed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/swap-transaction-changed.md): A swap portfolio transaction was created or updated.
- [Price trigger swap transaction changed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/price-trigger-swap-transaction-changed.md): A price-trigger swap portfolio transaction was created or updated.
- [Earn reward transaction changed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/earn-reward-transaction-changed.md): An earn-reward portfolio transaction was created or updated.
- [Deposit transaction changed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/deposit-transaction-changed.md): A deposit portfolio transaction was created or updated.

- [Deposit received](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/deposit-received.md): A deposit was received and is awaiting confirmations or checks.
- [Deposit held](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/deposit-held.md): A deposit is held pending review or additional checks.
- [Deposit credited](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/deposit-credited.md): A deposit was credited and can now be used.
- [Deposit returned](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/deposit-returned.md): A deposit was returned to its source.
- [Deposit failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/deposit-failed.md): A deposit failed and will not be credited.
- [Withdrawal held](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/withdrawal-held.md): A withdrawal is held pending review or additional checks.
- [Withdrawal complete](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/withdrawal-complete.md): A withdrawal completed successfully.
- [Withdrawal failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/withdrawal-failed.md): A withdrawal failed and will not be completed. Canceled withdrawals are excluded.
- [Verification requirements updated](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/verification-requirements-updated.md): The user's verification requirements changed.
- [Verification updated](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/verification-updated.md): A verification's status changed.
- [Price trigger swap executed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/price-trigger-swap-executed.md): A price-trigger swap executed successfully after its price condition was met.
- [Price trigger swap execution failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/price-trigger-swap-execution-failed.md): A price-trigger swap execution was attempted but failed.
- [Price trigger swap canceled](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/price-trigger-swap-canceled.md): A price-trigger swap was canceled before or during execution.

- [Recurring swap created](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/recurring-swap-created.md): A recurring swap was created and will submit trades on its requested schedule.
- [Recurring swap executed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/recurring-swap-executed.md): An occurrence of a recurring swap executed successfully. The schedule remains active for subsequent occurrences.
- [Recurring swap execution failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/recurring-swap-execution-failed.md): An occurrence of a recurring swap failed. This event does not mean the schedule has stopped; a terminal failure is reported separately by recurring_swap.failed.
- [Recurring swap canceled](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/recurring-swap-canceled.md): A recurring swap was canceled at the user’s request and will submit no further occurrences.
- [Recurring swap failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/recurring-swap-failed.md): A recurring swap stopped permanently after a failure and will submit no further occurrences.
- [Recurring swap paused](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/recurring-swap-paused.md): A recurring swap was paused. Its schedule is retained, but occurrences will not run until it is resumed.
- [Recurring swap resumed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/production-live/webhooks/recurring-swap-resumed.md): A recurring swap was resumed and will submit trades on its schedule again.

Results include prepared and canceled conversions as well as conversions that have started.

- [Prepare on-demand conversion](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/prepare-on-demand-conversion.md): Creates an on-demand conversion in status `prepared`. Its price and fees are locked up to `expires_at`. The conversion does not start and does not reserve funds. To start it, call [Execute prepared on-demand conversion](./execute-prepared-on-demand-conversion) before `expires_at`. To start a convers…
- [Get on-demand conversion](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/get-on-demand-conversion.md): Returns an on-demand conversion and its current status, including conversions that are prepared or canceled.
- [Execute prepared on-demand conversion](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/execute-prepared-on-demand-conversion.md): Starts an on-demand conversion in status `prepared` at its locked price and fees. Call it before `expires_at`. After it starts, the conversion has the same lifecycle as a conversion from [Execute on-demand conversion](./execute-on-demand-conversion).
- [List conversion rules](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/list-conversion-rules.md): Lists conversion rules for the caller, ordered by `created_at` descending.
- [Create conversion rule](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/create-conversion-rule.md): Creates a new conversion rule. Provisions the inbound deposit endpoint (IBAN for fiat-source, crypto address for crypto-source) the caller will fund. Once funded, transactions are produced against this conversion rule and become observable via the transactions surface.
- [Get conversion rule](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/get-conversion-rule.md): Retrieves the current state of a previously created conversion rule.
- [Update conversion rule](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/update-conversion-rule.md): Updates an existing conversion rule. Replaces the destination, name, and status in a single PUT. If you send `fee`, the update replaces the current fee. If you omit `fee`, the update keeps the current fee. If you send `fee` with `bps` set to `0`, the update sets a zero fee. If you send an empty `fee…
- [Delete conversion rule](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/delete-conversion-rule.md): Deletes a conversion rule (soft-delete). Inbound funds already received continue to settle; future deposits are rejected. Re-deleting an already-deleted conversion rule returns `404 NotFound`. Partners cannot distinguish "deleted" from "never existed".
- [List conversion rule transactions](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/list-conversion-rule-transactions.md): Lists transactions produced by a single conversion rule, ordered by `created_at` descending.
- [Simulate conversion rule deposit](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/simulate-conversion-rule-deposit.md): Simulates an inbound deposit against an existing conversion rule in the sandbox environment. This operation is unavailable in production.
- [Estimate conversion rule](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/estimate-conversion-rule.md): Returns the indicative amounts, rate, and fees for a hypothetical deposit to an existing conversion rule. An estimate does not lock a price, reserve funds, or change the conversion rule.
- [Estimate new conversion rule by account](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/conversions/estimate-new-conversion-rule-by-account.md): Uses the authorized account's country to estimate a conversion rule before you create it.

- [Calculate funding fees](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/calculate-funding-fees.md): Calculates a fee quote for a gross amount using one deposit or withdrawal method. Each request creates a new quote and moves no funds.
- [Create withdrawal](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/create-withdrawal.md): Creates a fiat or cryptocurrency withdrawal from the selected account to a registered funding address or a supported linked bank account.
- [List deposit addresses](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/list-deposit-addresses.md): Lists deposit destinations available for a funding method on the selected account. Reuse a page token only with the account and funding method used to obtain it.
- [Claim deposit address](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/claim-deposit-address.md): Claims a crypto deposit address for a funding method available to the selected account. Bitcoin over Lightning uses a per-payment invoice instead of a reusable address; use Create Lightning invoice. Compatible funding methods can share address limits, so list and reuse an existing address before cla…
- [List funding addresses](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/list-funding-addresses.md): Lists user-added withdrawal addresses registered for the selected account. Omit both filters to list all user-added withdrawal addresses. Use List deposit addresses for claimed deposit addresses.
- [Create funding address](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/create-funding-address.md): Registers a user-added fiat or cryptocurrency funding address for withdrawals on the selected account. Registration may activate an applicable funding method.
- [Create Lightning invoice](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/create-lightning-invoice.md): Creates a single-use BOLT11 invoice for a fixed-amount Bitcoin Lightning deposit. Each request creates a new invoice and is non-idempotent; after an unknown outcome, request a new invoice. Amounts outside the Lightning deposit limits reported by List deposit methods return `400`. Completed deposits…
- [Get funding address](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/get-funding-address.md): Returns one user-added fiat or cryptocurrency funding address registered for the selected account.
- [Delete funding address](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/delete-funding-address.md): Permanently deletes a user-added funding address for the selected account. Claimed deposit addresses cannot be deleted through this operation.
- [Update funding address](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/update-funding-address.md): Renames a user-added funding address for the selected account.
- [Create transfer](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/create-transfer.md): Creates a transfer between accounts in the authenticated caller's program.
- [Simulate funding deposit](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/funding/simulate-funding-deposit.md): Inserts a synthetic successful deposit for a funding method available to the selected account. Use this operation only in non-production test environments. It is unavailable in production.
- [List open positions](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/portfolio/list-open-positions.md): List open derivatives positions for the selected account.
- [Get portfolio](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/portfolio/get-portfolio.md): Returns one account portfolio snapshot containing account-level values and the per-asset breakdown. Quote-denominated monetary amounts use an `_in_quote` suffix; native asset amounts omit the suffix.
- [List portfolio history](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/portfolio/list-portfolio-history.md): Returns daily portfolio valuation snapshots for an account over the requested time window. Use `assets` to include per-asset balances for selected holdings.
- [List portfolio transactions](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/portfolio/list-portfolio-transactions.md): Lists account portfolio transactions with optional filters for type, asset, status, transaction ID, originating reference, time range, and sort direction. Results are cursor-paginated. Results are ordered newest first by default; set `sort_direction=asc` for oldest first. Page tokens are valid for u…
- [List funding history](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/portfolio/list-funding-history.md): **Available only for the International/EEA offering.**
- [List bank links](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/list-bank-links.md): Lists the account's Bank Links with their nested active Account Links, ordered by link time descending. Links that are still being completed and unlinked links are not returned. Results are paged: follow `next_page_token` until it is absent. Eligibility is computed fresh on every read, so a link's r…
- [Create bank link](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/create-bank-link.md): Creates a Bank Link (a connection between this account and one banking institution) for a funding method that requires linking. Returns it in `pending` with a hosted-widget URL; send the user there to choose their institution and approve access. Each shared bank account that links successfully becom…
- [List Ramp buy cryptocurrency assets](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/list-ramp-buy-cryptocurrency-assets.md): List cryptocurrency assets supported for Ramp buy transactions, including networks and withdrawal methods.
- [Get Ramp checkout URL](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/get-ramp-checkout-url.md): Generate a hosted Ramp checkout URL for the provided transaction configuration. The response echoes the request parameters so the Ramp partner can confirm what was submitted.
- [List Ramp countries](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/list-ramp-countries.md): List countries and subdivision groups supported for Ramp deposits.
- [List Ramp fiat currencies](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/list-ramp-fiat-currencies.md): List fiat currencies supported for funding Ramp transactions.
- [Get Ramp limits](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/get-ramp-limits.md): Retrieve combined min/max limits for a Ramp transaction configuration.
- [List Ramp payment methods](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/list-ramp-payment-methods.md): List fiat funding methods supported for Ramp deposits.
- [Get Ramp prospective quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/get-ramp-prospective-quote.md): Retrieve a prospective quote for a Ramp transaction without reserving liquidity. Use this to preview the from/to amounts before creating a checkout URL.
- [Create Ramp checkout session](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/create-ramp-checkout-session.md): Creates a Ramp checkout for a selected user and returns the widget redirect URL with the checkout UUID in the fragment. No access token is minted here; the widget mints it via the bootstrap call (`BootstrapRampCheckout`). The URL must still be treated as sensitive because the UUID is a capability ha…
- [Get bank link](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/get-bank-link.md): Retrieves a Bank Link and its nested active Account Links. Unlinked links are not returned.
- [Unlink bank link](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/unlink-bank-link.md): Severs the whole Bank Link: the link becomes `unlinked` and every Account Link is soft-removed. Unlinked links disappear from get and list and are rejected for new money movement; Account Link ids remain referenceable in history.
- [Reconnect bank link](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/ramp/reconnect-bank-link.md): Reconnects a Bank Link whose provider connection expired or was revoked. Returns it in `pending` with a fresh hosted-widget URL; the user re-authorizes through the provider, and a stored credential is never reused.
- [List settlement reports](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/reports/list-settlement-reports.md): Retrieves a paginated list of settlement reports available to the authenticated Master User, with optional filters for date range and report type.
- [Get settlement report](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/reports/get-settlement-report.md): Retrieves a settlement report and provides a secure download URL for the authenticated Master User.
- [Connection](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/market-data-stream/connection.md): One connection carries any number of feeds, each one channel of one instrument.
- [Ticker (level 1)](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/market-data-stream/ticker-level-1.md): The `ticker` channel streams level 1 market data: the best bid and ask, and the last trade.
- [Book (level 2)](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/market-data-stream/book-level-2.md): The `book` channel streams the level 2 order book: the aggregated quantity at each price level, best first.
- [OHLC](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/market-data-stream/ohlc.md): The `ohlc` channel streams OHLC (open, high, low, close) candles of one `interval` and `tick_type`.
- [Trade](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/market-data-stream/trade.md): The `trade` channel streams trades as they happen. It has no snapshot.
- [Create quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/swaps/create-quote.md): Creates an account-funded quote.
- [Get quote limits](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/swaps/get-quote-limits.md): Returns the effective amount limits for a swap on the selected account.
- [Get quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/swaps/get-quote.md): Returns a quote by ID. Use this to check status after creating or executing a quote.
- [Execute quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/swaps/execute-quote.md): Executes a quote that is still `offered` and not expired.
- [List onchain quotes](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/onchain-quotes/list-onchain-quotes.md): Returns onchain quotes for the account. Use `page_size` and `page_token` to page through results.
- [Create onchain quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/onchain-quotes/create-onchain-quote.md): Creates a wallet-funded quote and returns onchain execution details.
- [Get soft quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/onchain-quotes/get-soft-quote.md): Returns a short-lived indicative price for a wallet-funded onchain swap.
- [Get onchain quote](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/onchain-quotes/get-onchain-quote.md): Returns an onchain quote by ID, including execution details when available.
- [List price-triggered swaps](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/price-trigger-swaps/list-price-triggered-swaps.md): Returns price-triggered swaps for the account. Use `page_size` and `page_token` to page through results.
- [Create price-triggered swap](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/price-trigger-swaps/create-price-triggered-swap.md): Creates a swap that submits a trade when its price condition is met.
- [Get price-triggered swap](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/price-trigger-swaps/get-price-triggered-swap.md): Returns a price-triggered swap by ID. Use this to check status and inspect the requested or executed trade.
- [Cancel price-triggered swap](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/price-trigger-swaps/cancel-price-triggered-swap.md): Cancels a price-triggered swap that is still `active`. Swaps in any other status return `409 Conflict`.
- [Create Travel Rule verification](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/travel-rule-verifications/create-travel-rule-verification.md): Creates a Travel Rule verification case for a known wallet address.
- [Get Travel Rule verification](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/travel-rule-verifications/get-travel-rule-verification.md): Gets a previously returned proactive Travel Rule verification case.
- [Create user](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/users/create-user.md): Create a new account-owned user in the Payward system.
- [Get user](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/users/get-user.md): Retrieve a previously created user by their user ID.
- [Create user account](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/users/create-user-account.md): Create an additional account for an existing user.
- [Get verification](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/verifications/get-verification.md): Get a verification summary for the given user and verification ID.
- [List verifications](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/verifications/list-verifications.md): List verification summaries for the given user.
- [Get verification requirements](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/verifications/get-verification-requirements.md): Get the user's verification state and ordered required actions. The `user_action_required` field is true only when the user or partner can complete an action now. A `wait` action is non-actionable.
- [Submit verification evidence](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/verifications/submit-verification-evidence.md): Submit identity documents, residence documents, selfies, or liveness videos already verified by your provider. Provide each file through an HTTPS URL on an approved domain.
- [Create hosted verification](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/verifications/create-hosted-verification.md): Create or reuse the hosted verification required for the user.
- [Update verification profile](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/verifications/update-verification-profile.md): Update a user's verification profile. Changes to verified details may require verification again. Read verification requirements to check the user's status.
- [Create reusable KYC token](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/verifications/create-reusable-kyc-token.md): Create a single-use token that copies the user's approved identity verification into your own Sumsub account through Sumsub Reusable KYC.
- [List webhooks](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/list-webhooks.md): Lists the webhooks registered for the specified account.
- [Create webhook](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/create-webhook.md): Registers a new webhook destination for the specified account.
- [Get webhook](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/get-webhook.md): Retrieves a webhook by id.
- [Delete webhook](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/delete-webhook.md): Hard-deletes a webhook. The endpoint is removed entirely; future events will not be delivered to its URL and historical delivery attempts are no longer retrievable. To stop deliveries while keeping the audit trail, use UpdateWebhook with `disabled = true`.
- [Update webhook](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/update-webhook.md): Updates a webhook's mutable fields. Stripe-style partial PATCH: any field omitted from the request body is left unchanged. Use `disabled = true` to soft-disable an endpoint without deleting its delivery history.
- [List webhook attempts](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/list-webhook-attempts.md): Lists delivery attempts made to this webhook, most recent first.
- [Rotate webhook secret](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/rotate-webhook-secret.md): Rotates the webhook's signing secret and returns the new value.
- [Send webhook test event](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/send-webhook-test-event.md): Sends a test event to the webhook.
- [Quote executed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/quote-executed.md): Quote successfully executed against the partner account.
- [Quote canceled](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/quote-canceled.md): Quote canceled before execution.
- [Quote execution failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/quote-execution-failed.md): Quote execution attempted but failed.
- [User closed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/user-closed.md): The user's account was closed.
- [User disabled](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/user-disabled.md): The user's account became disabled.
- [Conversion deposit completed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/conversion-deposit-completed.md): Inbound funds were credited for a conversion transaction.
- [Conversion deposit failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/conversion-deposit-failed.md): The inbound funding leg failed for a conversion transaction.
- [Conversion deposit held](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/conversion-deposit-held.md): The inbound funding leg is held pending review for a conversion transaction.
- [Conversion withdrawal completed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/conversion-withdrawal-completed.md): Outbound settlement completed for a conversion transaction.
- [Conversion withdrawal failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/conversion-withdrawal-failed.md): The outbound settlement leg failed for a conversion transaction.
- [Conversion quote execution failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/conversion-quote-execution-failed.md): Quote creation or execution failed for a pre-quote conversion transaction.
- [Conversion blocked by travel rule](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/conversion-blocked-by-travel-rule.md): A pre-trade Travel Rule check blocked the conversion before any quote execution.
- [Conversion quote executed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/conversion-quote-executed.md): Quote execution completed for a conversion transaction.
- [Conversion canceled](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/conversion-canceled.md): An on-demand conversion in status `prepared` was canceled before execution. Its `status` is `canceled`, and `cancellation_reason` tells why. The payload does not include amounts, the rate, or fees. To read the full state, use [Get on-demand conversion](../conversions/get-on-demand-conversion).
- [Swap transaction changed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/swap-transaction-changed.md): A swap portfolio transaction was created or updated.
- [Price trigger swap transaction changed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/price-trigger-swap-transaction-changed.md): A price-trigger swap portfolio transaction was created or updated.
- [Earn reward transaction changed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/earn-reward-transaction-changed.md): An earn-reward portfolio transaction was created or updated.
- [Deposit transaction changed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/deposit-transaction-changed.md): A deposit portfolio transaction was created or updated.
- [Withdrawal transaction changed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/withdrawal-transaction-changed.md): A withdrawal portfolio transaction was created or updated.
- [Transfer transaction changed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/transfer-transaction-changed.md): A transfer portfolio transaction was created or updated.
- [Recurring swap transaction changed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/recurring-swap-transaction-changed.md): A recurring swap portfolio transaction was created or updated.
- [Deposit received](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/deposit-received.md): A deposit was received and is awaiting confirmations or checks.
- [Deposit held](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/deposit-held.md): A deposit is held pending review or additional checks.
- [Deposit credited](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/deposit-credited.md): A deposit was credited and can now be used.
- [Deposit returned](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/deposit-returned.md): A deposit was returned to its source.
- [Deposit failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/deposit-failed.md): A deposit failed and will not be credited.
- [Withdrawal held](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/withdrawal-held.md): A withdrawal is held pending review or additional checks.
- [Withdrawal complete](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/withdrawal-complete.md): A withdrawal completed successfully.
- [Withdrawal failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/withdrawal-failed.md): A withdrawal failed and will not be completed. Canceled withdrawals are excluded.
- [Verification requirements updated](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/verification-requirements-updated.md): The user's verification requirements changed.
- [Verification updated](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/verification-updated.md): A verification's status changed.
- [Price trigger swap executed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/price-trigger-swap-executed.md): A price-trigger swap executed successfully after its price condition was met.
- [Price trigger swap execution failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/price-trigger-swap-execution-failed.md): A price-trigger swap execution was attempted but failed.
- [Price trigger swap canceled](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/price-trigger-swap-canceled.md): A price-trigger swap was canceled before or during execution.
- [Price trigger swap created](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/price-trigger-swap-created.md): A price-trigger swap was created and is waiting for its price condition.
- [Price trigger swap failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/price-trigger-swap-failed.md): A price-trigger swap reached a terminal failure state.
- [Recurring swap created](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/recurring-swap-created.md): A recurring swap was created and will submit trades on its requested schedule.
- [Recurring swap executed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/recurring-swap-executed.md): An occurrence of a recurring swap executed successfully. The schedule remains active for subsequent occurrences.
- [Recurring swap execution failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/recurring-swap-execution-failed.md): An occurrence of a recurring swap failed. This event does not mean the schedule has stopped; a terminal failure is reported separately by recurring_swap.failed.
- [Recurring swap canceled](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/recurring-swap-canceled.md): A recurring swap was canceled at the user’s request and will submit no further occurrences.
- [Recurring swap failed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/recurring-swap-failed.md): A recurring swap stopped permanently after a failure and will submit no further occurrences.
- [Recurring swap paused](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/recurring-swap-paused.md): A recurring swap was paused. Its schedule is retained, but occurrences will not run until it is resumed.
- [Recurring swap resumed](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/recurring-swap-resumed.md): A recurring swap was resumed and will submit trades on its schedule again.
- [Derivatives order updated](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/derivatives-order-updated.md): Latest state of a US or EEA perpetuals order after it is placed, changed, filled, canceled, expired or rejected. - [Derivatives margin updated](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/derivatives-margin-updated.md): US perpetuals margin state after an account update. The user identifies whose margin changed, including a partner's end users. Each update carries the complete margin state. This event does not provide an initial snapshot or EEA perpetuals margin. Delivery can be retried and is not guaranteed to be…
- [Ramp transaction updated](https://docs.services.payward.com/api-reference/sandbox/webhooks/ramp-transaction-updated.md): Triggered when a crypto purchase that a buyer started through a partner's Ramp widget checkout reaches a new state.
